rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the lowest or deepest part, including the bottom of a container.

example.english: There is some sand at the bottom of the jar.
example.jyutping: go3 zeon1 ge3 dai2 jau5 di1 saa1

rows.note: Use this for clothing worn on the lower half of the body, including trousers and pyjama bottoms.

example.english: This bottom goes well with that top.
example.traditional: 呢條褲同嗰件上衣好襯。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 fu3 tung4 go2 gin6 soeng6 ji1 hou2 can3

rows.note: Use this colloquial noun for the buttocks or, depending on context, the anus.

example.english: My bottom hurts after sitting for too long.
example.jyutping: ngo5 co5 noi6 zo2 pei3 gu2 dou1 tung3 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the last or lowest position in a league table or ranking.

example.english: Their team fell to the bottom of the league this season.
example.traditional: 佢哋隊波今季跌到榜尾。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 deoi6 bo1 gam1 gwai3 dit3 dou3 bong2 mei5
